    source: str

        self._connections: list[sqlite3.Connection] = []

class TTLCache:

        if entry is None:

        value, expires_at = entry
        if time.time() > expires_at:
            del self._store[key]
            return None
        return value

    def delete(self, key):
        self._store.pop(key, None)
